                uint256 word;
                for (uint256 j = 0; j < 32 && i * 32 + j < len; j++) {
                    word |= uint256(uint8(data[i * 32 + j])) << (8 * (31 - j));
                }
                _storeUint(dataSlot + i, word);
            }
        }
    }

    function _readBytes(uint256 slot) internal view returns (bytes memory) {
        return bytes(_readString(slot));
    }

    function _storeBytes(uint256 slot, bytes memory data) internal {
        _storeString(slot, string(data));
    }

    function _compareStrings(string memory a, string memory b) internal pure returns (bool) {
        return keccak256(bytes(a)) == keccak256(bytes(b));
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed approved, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event Paused(address account);
    event Unpaused(address account);
    event Minted(address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 price, string uri);
    event Purchase(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 tokenId, uint256 price, string uri);
    event PriceUpdate(address indexed owner, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 oldPrice, uint256 newPrice);
    event NftListStatus(address indexed owner, uint256 indexed tokenId, bool isListed);
    event CreateAuction(address indexed owner, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 price, uint256 duration);
    event Bidding(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 amount);
    event CancelBid(uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event CancelAuction(uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event EndAuction(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 amount);
    event SetCancelFee(uint256 fee);
    event FeePaused();
    event FeeUnPaused();
    event CancelFeePaused();
    event CancelFeeUnPaused();

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!paused(), "Pausable: paused");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenPaused() {
        require(paused(), "Pausable: not paused");
        _;
    }

    constructor(string memory name_, string memory symbol_) {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        _name = name_;
        _symbol = symbol_;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    // ERC165
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public pure override returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == type(IERC165).interfaceId ||
               interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || // ERC721
               interfaceId == 0x780e9d63 || // ERC721Enumerable
               interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f;   // ERC721Metadata
    }

    // ERC721Metadata
    function name() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function baseURI() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _baseURI;
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721Metadata: URI query for nonexistent token");
        string memory base = _baseURI;
        return string(abi.encodePacked(base, _toString(tokenId)));
    }

    // ERC721
    function balanceOf(address owner_) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: balance query for zero address");
        return _balances[owner_];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");
        return owner_;
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(to != owner_, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(msg.sender == owner_ || isApprovedForAll(owner_, msg.sender),
            "ERC721: approve caller is not owner nor approved for all");
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(owner_, to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: approved query for nonexistent token");
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner_, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[owner_][operator];
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    // ERC721Enumerable
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address owner_, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: balance query for zero address");
        require(index < _balances[owner_], "EnumerableSet: index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[owner_][index];
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _allTokens.length, "EnumerableMap: index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[index];
    }

    // Ownable
    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        require(!paused(), "Pausable: paused");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    // Pausable
    function pause() external onlyOwner {
        _setPaused(true);
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

    function unpause() external onlyOwner {
        _setPaused(false);
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }

    function paused() public view returns (bool) {
        return (_pauseFlags & 1) == 1;
    }

    // Fee management
    function feeRate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _feeRate;
    }

    function setFee(uint256 fee) external onlyOwner {
        require(fee <= 100, "Fee too high");
        _feeRate = fee;
    }

    function feePaused() external view returns (bool) {
        return (_pauseFlags & 2) == 2;
    }

    function feePause() external onlyOwner {
        _pauseFlags |= 2;
        emit FeePaused();
    }

    function feeUnPause() external onlyOwner {
        require(!paused(), "Pausable: paused");
        _pauseFlags &= ~uint256(2);
        emit FeeUnPaused();
    }

    // Cancel fee management
    function cancelFeeRate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _cancelFee;
    }

    function setCancelFee(uint256 fee) external onlyOwner {
        require(fee <= 100, "Fee too high");
        _cancelFee = fee;
        emit SetCancelFee(fee);
    }

    function cancelFeePaused() external view returns (bool) {
        return (_pauseFlags & 4) == 4;
    }

    function cancelFeePause() external onlyOwner {
        _pauseFlags |= 4;
        emit CancelFeePaused();
    }

    function cancelFeeUnPause() external onlyOwner {
        _pauseFlags &= ~uint256(4);
        emit CancelFeeUnPaused();
    }

    // Accepted tokens
    function allAcceptedTokens() external view returns (bool) {
        return (_pauseFlags & 0x100) != 0;
    }

    function setAllAcceptedTokens(bool status) external onlyOwner {
        if (status) {
            _pauseFlags |= 0x100;
        } else {
            _pauseFlags &= ~uint256(0x100);
        }
    }

    function acceptedTokens(address token) external view returns (bool) {
        return _acceptedTokens[token];
    }

    function tokenAccepted(address token) external view returns (bool) {
        return _acceptedTokens[token];
    }

    function tokenDenial(address token) external view returns (bool) {
        return _tokenDenial[token];
    }

    // Minting
    function mint(address to, string memory uri, address tokenAddress, uint256 price) external onlyOwner {
        uint256 tokenId = _tokenIdCounter;
        _tokenIdCounter++;
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        _prices[tokenId] = price;
        _saleTokenAddresses[tokenId] = tokenAddress;
        emit Minted(to, tokenId, price, uri);
    }

    function auctionMint(address to, string memory uri, address tokenAddress, uint256 price, uint256 duration) external onlyOwner {
        uint256 tokenId = _tokenIdCounter;
        _tokenIdCounter++;
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        _createAuction(tokenAddress, tokenId, price, duration);
        emit Minted(to, tokenId, price, uri);
    }

    function burn(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: burn caller is not owner nor approved");
        _burn(tokenId);
    }

    // Marketplace
    function price(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _prices[tokenId];
    }

    function listedMap(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _listedMap[tokenId];
    }

    function saleTokenAddresses(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        return _saleTokenAddresses[tokenId];
    }

    function updatePrice(uint256 tokenId, uint256 newPrice) external {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner_ == msg.sender, "ERC721: caller is not owner");
        uint256 oldPrice = _prices[tokenId];
        _prices[tokenId] = newPrice;
        emit PriceUpdate(msg.sender, tokenId, oldPrice, newPrice);
    }

    function updateListingStatus(uint256 tokenId, bool isListed) external {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner_ == msg.sender, "ERC721: caller is not owner");
        _listedMap[tokenId] = isListed;
        emit NftListStatus(msg.sender, tokenId, isListed);
    }

    function updateSale(address tokenAddress, uint256 tokenId, uint256 price_) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _saleTokenAddresses[tokenId] = tokenAddress;
        _prices[tokenId] = price_;
    }

    function buy(uint256 tokenId) external payable whenNotPaused {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: operator query for nonexistent token");
        require(_listedMap[tokenId], "Token not listed");
        require(!_hasAuction[tokenId] || (_auctionFlags & 1) == 0, "Auction active");
        
        uint256 tokenPrice = _prices[tokenId];
        require(msg.value >= tokenPrice, "Insufficient payment");
        
        address tokenAddress = _saleTokenAddresses[tokenId];
        uint256 feeAmount = (tokenPrice * _feeRate) / 100;
        
        _transfer(owner_, msg.sender, tokenId);
        _listedMap[tokenId] = false;
        
        if (tokenAddress == address(0)) {
            payable(owner_).transfer(tokenPrice - feeAmount);
        }
        
        emit Purchase(owner_, msg.sender, tokenId, tokenPrice, "");
    }

    // Auction functions
    function hasAuction(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {
        return _hasAuction[tokenId];
    }

    function bids(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256 amount, address bidder, bool exists) {
        Bid storage bid_ = _bids[tokenId];
        return (bid_.amount, bid_.bidder, bid_.exists);
    }

    function offers(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _offers;
    }

    function createAuction(address tokenAddress, uint256 tokenId, uint256 price_, uint256 duration) external {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _createAuction(tokenAddress, tokenId, price_, duration);
    }

    function _createAuction(address tokenAddress, uint256 tokenId, uint256 price_, uint256 duration) internal {
        require(duration >= 60, "Duration too short");
        _hasAuction[tokenId] = true;
        _auctions[tokenId] = Auction({
            price: price_,
            duration: duration,
            startTime: block.timestamp,
            owner: msg.sender,
            tokenAddress: tokenAddress,
            active: true
        });
        emit CreateAuction(msg.sender, tokenId, price_, duration);
    }

    function bid(uint256 tokenId, uint256 amount_) external payable whenNotPaused {
        require(_hasAuction[tokenId], "No auction for token");
        Auction storage auction = _auctions[tokenId];
        require(auction.active, "Auction not active");
        require(block.timestamp < auction.startTime + auction.duration, "Auction ended");
        require(amount_ > auction.price, "Bid too low");
        
        if (_bids[tokenId].exists) {
            payable(_bids[tokenId].bidder).transfer(_bids[tokenId].amount);
        }
        
        _bids[tokenId] = Bid({
            amount: amount_,
            bidder: msg.sender,
            exists: true
        });
        auction.price = amount_;
        
        emit Bidding(tokenId, amount_);
    }

    function cancelBid(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_bids[tokenId].bidder == msg.sender, "Not bidder");
        uint256 amount_ = _bids[tokenId].amount;
        _bids[tokenId] = Bid({amount: 0, bidder: address(0), exists: false});
        payable(msg.sender).transfer(amount_);
        emit CancelBid(tokenId);
    }

    function cancelAuction(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_hasAuction[tokenId], "No auction for token");
        Auction storage auction = _auctions[tokenId];
        require(auction.owner == msg.sender || _owner == msg.sender, "Not auction owner");
        require(auction.active, "Auction not active");
        
        auction.active = false;
        _hasAuction[tokenId] = false;
        
        if (_bids[tokenId].exists) {
            payable(_bids[tokenId].bidder).transfer(_bids[tokenId].amount);
            _bids[tokenId] = Bid({amount: 0, bidder: address(0), exists: false});
        }
        
        emit CancelAuction(tokenId);
    }

    function endAuction(uint256 tokenId) external {
        require(_hasAuction[tokenId], "No auction for token");
        Auction storage auction = _auctions[tokenId];
        require(block.timestamp >= auction.startTime + auction.duration, "Auction not ended");
        
        uint256 amount_ = auction.price;
        address winner = _bids[tokenId].bidder;
        
        if (winner != address(0)) {
            _transfer(auction.owner, winner, tokenId);
            uint256 feeAmount = (amount_ * _feeRate) / 100;
            payable(auction.owner).transfer(amount_ - feeAmount);
        }
        
        auction.active = false;
        _hasAuction[tokenId] = false;
        _bids[tokenId] = Bid({amount: 0, bidder: address(0), exists: false});
        
        emit EndAuction(tokenId, amount_);
    }

    // Admin
    function setBaseURI(string memory baseURI_) external onlyOwner {
        _baseURI = baseURI_;
    }

    function _contractOwner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    // Internal functions
    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: operator query for nonexistent token");
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        return (spender == owner_ || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender || isApprovedForAll(owner_, spender));
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(_owners[tokenId] == from, "ERC721: transfer of token that is not own");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to zero address");
        
        _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId);
        
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0);
        emit Approval(from, address(0), tokenId);
        
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721 implementer");
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to zero address");
        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");
        
        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
        
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _burn(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        
        _beforeTokenTransfer(owner_, address(0), tokenId);
        
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0);
        emit Approval(owner_, address(0), tokenId);
        
        _balances[owner_] -= 1;
        delete _owners[tokenId];
        
        emit Transfer(owner_, address(0), tokenId);
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (from != to) {
            _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        }
        if (to == address(0)) {
            _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);
        } else if (to != from) {
            _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);
        }
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 length = _balances[to];
        _ownedTokens[to][length] = tokenId;
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = length;
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _balances[from] - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
        
        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }
        
        delete _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
    }

    function _removeTokenFromAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) private {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        uint256 lastTokenId = _allTokens[lastTokenIndex];
        
        _allTokens[tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
        _allTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        
        delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        _allTokens.pop();
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
                return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
            } catch (bytes memory reason) {
                if (reason.length == 0) {
                    revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721 implementer");
                } else {
                    assembly {
                        revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    function _setPaused(bool status) internal {
        if (status) {
            _pauseFlags |= 1;
        } else {
            _pauseFlags &= ~uint256(1);
        }
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

        require(amount > 0, "Transfer amount must be greater than zero");
        require(!_isBlacklisted[sender] && !_isBlacklisted[recipient], "Blacklisted address");

        if (sender != owner() && recipient != owner()) {
            require(tradingActive, "Trading is not active yet.");
        }

        if (!_excludedFromTransactionlock[sender] && !_excludedFromTransactionlock[recipient]) {
            require(block.timestamp >= transactionlockTime, "Transaction lock is active.");
        }

        if (!_excludedFromMaxTxAmount[sender] && !_excludedFromMaxTxAmount[recipient]) {
            if (sender == pancakePair) {
                require(amount <= _maxTxAmountBuy, "Buy amount exceeds the maxTxAmount.");
            } else if (recipient == pancakePair) {
                require(amount <= _maxTxAmountSell, "Sell amount exceeds the maxTxAmount.");
            }
        }

        if (!_excludedFromAntiWhale[recipient]) {
            require(balanceOf(recipient) + amount <= _maxTokensPerAddress, "Exceeds max tokens per address.");
        }

        if (swapAndLiquifyEnabled && sender != pancakePair && sender != owner() && recipient != owner()) {
            uint256 contractTokenBalance = balanceOf(address(this));
            if (contractTokenBalance >= _numTokensSellToAndTransfer) {
                swapAndLiquify(_numTokensSellToAndTransfer);
            }
        }

        uint256 fees = 0;
        if (!_isExcludedFromFee[sender] && !_isExcludedFromFee[recipient]) {
            fees = amount * (_burnFee + _liquidityFee + _marketingFee) / 100;
        }

        uint256 amountReceived = amount - fees;
        _balances[sender] -= amount;
        _balances[recipient] += amountReceived;
        _balances[address(this)] += fees;

        emit Transfer(sender, recipient, amountReceived);
    }

        uint256 half = amount / 2;
        uint256 otherHalf = amount - half;

        uint256 initialBalance = address(this).balance;
        swapTokensForEth(half);
        uint256 newBalance = address(this).balance - initialBalance;

        addLiquidity(otherHalf, newBalance);
        emit SwapAndLiquify(half, newBalance, otherHalf);
    }

    function swapTokensForEth(uint256 tokenAmount) internal {
        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = address(this);
        path[1] = pancakeRouter.WETH();

        _approve(address(this), address(pancakeRouter), tokenAmount);
        pancakeRouter.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(
            tokenAmount,
            0,
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

        pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: ethAmount}(

            tokenAmount,
            0,
            0,
            _autoLiquidityReceiver,
            block.timestamp
